summary: FirstEnergy Pennsylvania Electric Company filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, announcing the launch of a registered exchange offer for up to $300 million of its outstanding unregistered 4.150% Senior Notes due 2028 and $550 million of its outstanding unregistered 4.550% Senior Notes due 2031, exchanging them for like principal amounts of registered notes. This is a routine SEC registration exchange offer, not a special situation. The filing provides forward-looking statements and an exhibit with a news release, but no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for the completion of the exchange offer and any changes to the unregistered notes' liquidity or registration status.
